QUOTE: "`code` | The running server process loaded clew before its source changed | Restarting the MCP client only" and "A stale process once rebuilt an index at an older version and dropped a layer while `status` reported it healthy, so writes from stale code are refused."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says stale-code writes are refused, but it never says reads stay current because query tools open the database per call, so the read/write asymmetry is absent.
